resources.string: Ask anything, or say “make an image of…”
Tap the A and try again.
Voice input needs the internet here. Try again, or type instead.
Another app is using speech right now. Try again in a moment.
Atelier Assist needs the microphone to hear you.
Turn on the microphone for Atelier Assist in Settings → Permissions.
Couldn’t use the microphone. Try again, or type instead.
This phone has no speech service. Type instead.
Speech isn’t available in your language here yet. Type instead, or try again.
No app on this phone can open Atelier.
Atelier isn’t installed here — opening it in the browser.
Opening in the browser — tap Send there.
Couldn’t verify the installed Atelier app — opening Atelier in the browser.
Paste your private link once, and Atelier sends what you say after its short pause. Without it, Atelier opens with your words in the box and you tap Send.
In Atelier: Settings → General → Quick launch → Android → Atelier Assist.
Turn on Send without a tap, then tap Copy Assist link.
Come back here and tap Paste link. Then delete the link from your keyboard’s clipboard history.
Paired — Atelier sends after its short hold. The first time, Atelier asks you to confirm.
Not paired — Atelier fills the box and you tap Send.
Paired. The link was cleared from the clipboard, but your keyboard may still keep a copy: open its clipboard history (Samsung Keyboard or Gboard) and delete the Atelier link there.
Your clipboard is empty — copy the link in Atelier first.
That isn’t a link. Copy the Assist link in Atelier, then tap Paste link.
That link has no private key. In Atelier, turn on Send without a tap, then copy the link again.
Unpaired on this phone. The key itself still works until you retire it: in Atelier, Settings → General → Quick launch → Atelier Assist → New link.
Atelier Assist is your digital assistant. Press and hold the side button to talk.
Make Atelier Assist your digital assistant: Settings → Apps → Choose default apps → Digital assistant app. Then Settings → Advanced features → Side button → Press and hold → Digital assistant.
Choose Digital assistant app, then Atelier Assist.

Only the key is kept, on this phone. Your phone’s speech service turns your voice into text (it may use Google’s servers or your phone maker’s); the words then go to Atelier. Atelier Assist stores neither.
